# Block `concepts`

**Use:** Show the lecture's defined concepts as cards. Every id must exist in the lecture's `concepts` list.

**Avoid:** Ids that are not defined in `concepts`.

## Example

```json
{
  "kind": "concepts",
  "ids": [
    "index",
    "selectivity"
  ],
  "source": [
    {
      "file": "slides.pdf",
      "page": 4
    }
  ]
}
```

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | `"concepts"` | yes |
| `source` | array of object (1–5) | no |
| `source[].file` | string | yes |
| `source[].page` | integer (≤ 9007199254740991) | yes |
| `ids` | array of string (pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$`) | yes |

Every block may carry `source`: 1–5 `{ "file", "page" }` references to the material it came from.
